list.title: How to use (Hair Growth Concentrate)
list.content:
Step 1
Apply on the entire scalp for 2 min.
Step 2
Massage gently with your fingers to ensure it is absorbed properly and leave it on.

With non-oily formulation, you can apply everyday without having to wash your hair before stepping out.

You can use it along with other hair oils, shampoos, serums and any other hair supplements.

list.title: Important Information
list.content: Bodywise’s Hair Growth Pack is developed by trichologists with safe & effective ingredients. In order to get long lasting results, you need to use this for at least 3 months.

list.title: Who should use this Hair Growth Pack?
list.content: These Biotin Gummies & natural plant based hair serum can be used by anyone who is experiencing Stage 2 Hair Loss (more than 100 strands of hair fall per day &  hair thinning on scalp).

list.title: How does the Hair Growth Pack work?
list.content: The Hair Growth Pack contains Hair Gummies and Hair Growth Serum. Our Hair Gummies contain essential multivitamins like Biotin, Zinc, and Vitamin A, C, and E that are crucial building blocks of hair and help curb hair fall. Our all natural Hair Growth Serum contains plant-based actives that stimulate hair follicles leading to hair growth.

list.title: Is it safe for pregnant women?
list.content: Pregnant women should not use Hair Gummies without consulting a doctor first.

list.title: Is it breastfeeding safe?
list.content: No, for breastfeeding mothers, we recommend using our post-pregnancy hair growth pack, designed specifically for postpartum hair fall. Follow this link: https://bebodywise.com/product/postpartum-severe-hairfall-1month-xp

list.title: Can a person with diabetes use it?
list.content: Our gummies are made from chicory root extract, which makes it completely sugar-free. It is absolutely safe for people with diabetes to consume. However, it is advisable to speak to an expert first.

list.title: Is it really sugar-free?
list.content: Yes, our gummies are made from chicory root extract, which makes it completely sugar-free.

list.title: Does it have any side-effects?
list.content: There are no side-effects. But it is recommended to visit your doctor to check for allergies prior to usage.

list.title: Can people below 18 use it?
list.content: This product is recommended only for women above 18 years of age.

list.title: How do Redensyl, Procapil, Baicapil help in Hair Growth?
list.content: Redensyl, Procapil, and Baicapil, all derived from plants, promote healthy hair growth by prolonging the anagen phase. They shorten the telogen phase, resulting in a significant decrease in hair loss.  These natural actives for hair growth are often considered the best alternative to hair transplants due to their all-natural and non-hormonal hair regrowth qualities.

list.title: Are your Hair gummies safe to eat?
list.content: Yes, Hair gummies are 100% safe to eat! They have no preservatives and no artificial colour. They are also Vegan, Gluten Free and Gelatin Free.
